documents.text: RSME-PPP project, the Holdfast consortium redeveloped the barracks and built a new officers' mess on the site so allowing the manor to be sold. 8th Engineer Brigade moved to Gibraltar Barracks in 2014. Gibraltar Barracks, Minley Gibraltar Barracks is a military installation at Minley in Hampshire. The barracks were established in the early 1970s on the opposite side of the A327 Minley Road to Minley Manor and initially accommodated an engineer brigade which relocated from Aldershot and various engineer recruit training units which transferred from Southwood Camp.
